variants.name: 11 rational
variants.description: Eleven pieces whose roofs form valleys and ridges. Fill the square tray so the roof forms one continuous surface.
notes: Tropical rational function P ⊘ Q = P − Q (max convention) over x, y in [-4, 4]; each piece is a cell of the common refinement of P and Q.

variants.name: 11 rational (flat)
variants.description: The 11 rational footprints with the relief removed. Fill the square tray; heights give no clues.
notes: Tropical rational function P ⊘ Q = P − Q (max convention) over x, y in [-4, 4]; each piece is a cell of the common refinement of P and Q.
Roof relief removed: every piece has the same uniform thickness.
